plan.title: Direct eRFX RFQ split award to PO

steps.note: Open the direct eRFX creation flow rather than starting from a purchase request.
Set the requested project title.
Configure the project as RFQ-only, removing the default Auction stage.
Configure the RFQ stage before selecting its template and items.
Apply the available RFQ pricing template.
Add one CYLINDER product matching the requested quantity of 10.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet after adding the line item.
Set the requested delivery location on the line item.
Verify the delivery location was retained.
Commit the required 30-minute event schedule.
Invite two QA vendors so two distinct vendor bids can be submitted.
Publish the direct RFQ event.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Submit the first vendor's quote of 100 through the vendor portal.
Verify the first vendor's quote was accepted.
Submit the second vendor's quote of 90 through a separate vendor identity.
Verify the second vendor's quote was accepted.
Verify the buyer sees both direct vendor responses.
Close the bidding window before opening awarding.
Open the comparison grid for the closed event with bids.
Verify two real vendor columns appear in Master QCS.
Verify the two vendor responses are ranked by RFQ amount.
Verify the displayed bid amounts and totals are arithmetically consistent.
Reach the awarding screen, which is the closest available observation before the unsupported split allocation.
Assert that the awarding screen is open and ready to create a proposal.
